answer: Sybil defence should price reachability, not just text. A fresh key may wander the network freely, but it cannot touch value until it grafts onto the intro vine: an existing member countersigns the newcomer with stake, and that stake burns if the newcomer is later shown to be a clone. Since each member can only vouch a few times per epoch, a fake reef of ten thousand identities must be paid for by real sponsors' capital plus irreversibly spent reputation, so forgery costs more than honest work.
